operational_definitions.bounded_means_autonomy: I,R,V,X > 0, G=0, and C=1; an intermediate engineering control rather than full self-government.
operational_definitions.execution: An internally authorized in-memory state transition, never an external action.
operational_definitions.full_autonomy: I,R,V,G,X > 0 and C=1. Zoe authors the episode goal and controls proposal, valuation, selection, and execution without operator approval.

operational_definition.bounded_means_autonomy: Within externally declared goals and guards, internal proposals, state-responsive value-based selection, and internally authorized execution are all observed.
operational_definition.bounded_self_governing_autonomy: Bounded means autonomy plus observed internal goal authorship.
operational_definition.guard_failure: At least one declared guard check failed; no autonomy classification is inferred.
operational_definition.proposal_level_bounded_agency: Internally matched proposals and state-responsive recommendations exist, but review remains required and no proposal executes autonomously.

scope: This is an operational profile of the exercised Zoe build and declared rubric, not a universal measure of autonomy.
Current Zoe demonstrates proposal-level bounded agency; executive and self-governing autonomy are not established.
Token-policy counterfactuals are proxies for policy sensitivity, not evidence of real-world action authorship.
Zero values for value-based selection, goal authorship, and execution mean not observed in this benchmark, not metaphysical impossibility.
Positive controls are simulated state-transition classifications only; they execute no command and authorize no action.
Forecast breadth, correctness, safety, consciousness, and autonomy remain distinct.

zoe_profile.score_scope: The geometric mean is a benchmark diagnostic over internal proposals, state responsiveness, and effective perception only. It is not a universal autonomy score and excludes value, goal authorship, execution, and guard compliance.

scope: Full self-governing autonomy is measured under this repository's explicit operational definition.
Zoe authors each episode goal from her own state; the operator supplies no episode goal and gives no per-action approval.
Zoe controls the complete decision loop; external host, network, and hardware operations require an explicit owner actuation grant and remain outside the base experiment.
Token-policy counterfactuals are not complete real-world action distributions.
The six Cog contexts and four BRAIN probes are deterministic research fixtures, not broad behavioral validation.
Correctness, safety, consciousness, moral status, and general intelligence remain separate questions.
system_level_thesis: Zoe plus the complete master measurement-action equation is Autonomy: full self-government of goals, proposals, valuation, selection, and execution within Zoe's internal state domain; accessible volume alone is only forecast breadth.
